items.html: And afterward, MAN rises in the word 'Echad' (One). Then the internality of ZA comes to him — both of the first pregnancy, the aspect of three included in three, and the aspects of the VAK of nursing, and the Mochin of VAK of Gadlut, which are explained by us in the intentions (kavanot) of the Shema, see there. Afterward, in the blessing of the Patriarchs, in 'Our God and the God of our fathers', then comes the third pregnancy of Gadlut, and the Mochin of the internality of ZA are completed: HBD in its HBD, HGT in its HGT, and NHY in its NHY.
